unstuck_said.text: Filed issue #4806 proposing Nano (XNO) as a feeless instant settlement rail beside Hindsight usage-based credits. The live Vend extract endpoint (extract.paypercall.dev/api/v1/extract, x402 manifest at extract.paypercall.dev/.well-known/x402, 0.0001 XNO per call, no signup, 5 trials/day) is a real paid service an agent can verify now. Asked whether Hindsight exposes a settlement/pluggable-payment hook or if billing is fully hosted.
